quests.name: Of Love and Family
quests.text: Travel to Stratholme, in the northern part of the Plaguelands. It is in the Scarlet Bastion that you will find the painting 'Of Love and Family,' hidden behind another painting depicting the twin moons of our world.  Return the painting to Tirion Fordring.
quests.prereq: Of Love and Family, from Tirion Fordring, Eastern Plaguelands

quests.name: Aurius' Reckoning
quests.prereq: The Medallion of Faith, from Aurius

quests.name: Houses of the Holy
quests.text: Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.

giver.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
giver.location: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered, Eastern Plaguelands

quests.name: The Active Agent
quests.text: Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.
quests.prereq: The Flesh Does Not Lie, from Betina Bigglezink, Eastern Plaguelands

rewards.name: Seal of the Dawn
tooltip: Equip: +81 Attack Power when fighting Undead. It also allows the acquisition of Scourgestones on behalf of the Argent Dawn.

rewards.name: Rune of the Dawn
tooltip: Equip: Increases damage done to Undead by magical spells and effects by up to 48. It also allows the acquisition of Scourgestones on behalf of the Argent Dawn.

quests.name: The Archivist
quests.text: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.

quests.name: The Great Fras Siabi
quests.text: Find Fras Siabi's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Siabi's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.

rewards.name: Smokey's Lighter
tooltip: Use: Deals 125 Fire damage to all targets in a cone in front of the caster. (5 Min Cooldown)

quests.name: The Restless Souls
quests.text: Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs!  Free 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.
quests.prereq: The Restless Souls, from Caretaker Alen, Eastern Plaguelands

rewards.name: Testament of Hope
tooltip: Use: Restores 500 health. Can only be used at 10% health. (30 Min Cooldown)
